title: Poiva Protocol — Common Definitions
description: Shared enum and primitive definitions referenced by every resource schema in the Poiva protocol. See docs/protocol/04-terminology.md for the prose definition of each concept.

id.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for a protocol resource.

missionState.description: Mission lifecycle state. See docs/protocol/05-mission.md section 7.

activityState.description: Activity lifecycle state. See docs/protocol/06-activity.md section 5.

verificationMode.description: How a verification is (or was) performed.

verificationOutcome.description: Result of a verification. PENDING denotes a verification awaiting an outcome.

settlementType.description: Mechanism by which a settlement is realized.

participantKind.description: The nature of a participant fulfilling or sponsoring work.
